articles.title: [SYNTHETIC] Pulsed-field versus thermal ablation for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation: a randomized trial
articles.abstract: Background: Pulsed field ablation (PFA) is an alternative to thermal ablation. Methods: In this multicenter randomized trial, a total of 412 patients with paroxysmal atrial fibrillation were randomized 1:1 to PFA or radiofrequency ablation. Rhythm was assessed with 72-hour Holter monitoring. Results: During a median follow-up of 12 months, freedom from atrial arrhythmia was 78.2% with PFA versus 74.0% with radiofrequency ablation (HR 0.84, 95% CI 0.61-1.15; p = 0.27). Major complications occurred in 1.0% and 1.5%. Conclusions: PFA was noninferior. A limitation is the open-label design. NCT99000101.

articles.title: [SYNTHETIC] Predictors of recurrence after cryoballoon pulmonary vein isolation
articles.abstract: This retrospective single-center cohort included 1,250 consecutive patients undergoing cryoballoon pulmonary vein isolation for atrial fibrillation. Recurrence at 2 years occurred in 31% of patients. Left atrial volume was associated with recurrence (aHR 1.42, 95% CI 1.10 to 1.83). Repeat ablation was performed in 140 patients, with pulmonary vein reconnection found in 61%.

articles.title: [SYNTHETIC] Esophageal injury after radiofrequency ablation for atrial fibrillation
articles.abstract: We report a case of esophageal injury after radiofrequency catheter ablation for atrial fibrillation detected by endoscopy on day three.
